# Embedding fixtures

`reference_text.json` contains synthetic cooking and Redis examples. The token
IDs and float32 vectors come from the official Sentence Transformers backend,
using `scripts/reference_text_embeddings.py`. The retained records are unchanged
from the original capture. A prose query and document with uncertain evaluation
provenance were removed before publication. Do not restore private evaluation
material when refreshing these fixtures.

`special_tokens.json` records literal control-token behavior and the SHA-256
of the pinned tokenizer. The `audio/` fixtures are mathematical signals and
reference features generated by `scripts/audio/generate.py` and
`scripts/audio/reference.py`. They contain no recorded speech. See
`ort/README.md` for the synthetic external-weight ONNX fixture.
